feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 August 2026 10:34pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 18 August 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland with a developing frontal wave affecting the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, perhaps touching force 6 in the east of the area overnight, then decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, occasionally increasing 5 in places for a time in the afternoon and evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Rain, clearing to showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, veering north or northeast 4 or 5 overnight into Thursday, and occasionally 6 in the northeast of the area early morning. Backing north or northwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
